### 2. Seva Setu — Public Services & Civic Tech Proposal
- **Category:** Innovation Proposal (1st Semester MBA, Team of 4)
- **Role:** Core Conceptualizer & Co-Author
- **Description:** Designed a civic tech digital platform proposal connecting citizens with municipal and government authorities. Features real-time civic issue reporting (roads, water supply, public lighting), engineer assessment workflows, public job creation, and emergency SOS response mechanisms.
- **Document PDF:** `pdfs/Seva Satu.pdf`

### 3. Market Research Study — Union Bank of India
- **Category:** Academic Research Project (1st Semester MBA)
- **Role:** Lead Researcher & Data Analyst
- **Description:** Conducted an in-depth empirical market research study on Union Bank of India. Analyzed consumer perception, brand positioning, customer satisfaction gaps, and the alignment between marketing claims and actual branch service delivery.
- **Document PDF:** `pdfs/Union bank of India.pdf`

### 4. Personal Interactive Portfolio Website
